_note: Newspaper transition layout, in 1920x1080 pixels. Colours are [r, g, b, a] from 0 to 255; opacities 0 to 1; angles in degrees. A page (and its shadow) offscreen past a screen edge is out of sight.

sheets._note: where each page comes to rest, in the order they arrive (a later page lies on top): bx, by the centre and s the scale. Every trip moves each by up to jitter_x / jitter_y in all (half each way), turns it by up to jitter_deg in all, and lays one in upside_down_chance upside down.

shadow._note: a resting page's shadow offset; a page lifted off the pile (lift 0 to 1) grows its shadow by lift_grow, fades it by lift_fade and moves it lift_x / lift_y further

title._note: room is the title's room on the screen; bold is the ink fills' offsets along the line; line_pitch is the line spacing in line heights; text_nudge moves the text inside its glyph box
